items.title: Hal Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Eddie Condon. People forget what a good guitar player he was.

ctx.x: It’s such a — we almost forget how tied that was to the Basie thing.

Yes. And not just Basie. Eddie Condon. People forget what a good guitar player he was. Not a soloist, but the time was as perfect as it could get. And it’s a lost art now, it really is, except at functions like this. Big bands don’t use rhythm guitar anymore.
Yeah. It seems to be something about the acoustic thing too.
